# DELIVERY-CLASS MAIL SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Medium
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-4
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Uranium x2
# Shuttle Brief
Silkworm Shipyards presents an advanced mail vessel, fully equipped for prolonged courier operations. From the modern bridge to the post office, to the comfortable break room, the Delivery makes sure yours arrive on time.
# Notable features
- The Delivery features an advanced bridge with controls and readouts for various functions of the ship. - The Conn Station (on the right of the captain's seat) allows direct control over the Delivery's propulsion systems. Refer to the wall-mounted light readouts for the current status of the system: no lights — Normal Mode; blue light only — Parking Mode; orange light only — Emergency Propulsion; orange light and blue light — full system shutdown. - The Tactical Station (behind the captain's seat) allows direct control of the Priority Ship Cannons installed in the gunnery room. Top button controls the blast doors; refer to the wall-mounted light readout for the current status of the doors: no lights — blast doors are closed; orange light — blast doors are open. Bottom button fires both cannons. REMINDER: Priory Ship Cannons must be reloaded manually.
- Spaceous post office allows efficient handling and processing of mail. Subfloor disposal system is easily accessible to encourage crews to optimize the layout of the office according to their preferences. - Bedrooms, bathroom and break room, all in the signature Green-Is-Here style ensure the crew's comfort on long-distance deliveries. - Bedrooms are equipped with light switches in purple frames and with window shutters linked to buttons in grey frames. - A withdraw-only ATM is accessible on either dock for convenient transactions.
# Technical Details
In standard configuration, the Delivery has a power load of 45.8 kW. Engaging Parking Mode brings this number down to 25.9 kW, and fully shutting down the navigational system — to 8 kW.
The ship is divided into two sections for the purposes of APC destribution: Bridge (powers the port dock, engineering and the bridge itself), and Post Office (powers the fore dock, office, gunnery, break room, bedrooms and bathroom).
The Delivery is equipped with 12 thrusters: 5 rear-facing (2 of those are large thrusters), 3 forward-facing and 4 side-facing (2 for each side).
